outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic showing genomic organization of genes, not a plot of quantitative data.

Panel B is a scatter/mean plot (with an accompanying photograph of disk diffusion assays) showing inhibition zone percentages as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each biological replicate.
Panel C is a scatter/mean plot (plus photograph) showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each replicate clearly displayed.
Panel D is a scatter/mean plot (plus photograph) showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each replicate clearly displayed.
Panel E is a line plot of growth over time (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying raw points would reduce readability.
Panel F is a line plot of growth over time (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G is a line plot of growth over time (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
